title: Brazilian Voter ID Validator
description: Check in the browser whether a Brazilian voter registration number has a compatible UF code and check digits, without querying electoral status.
metaDescription: Check in the browser whether a Brazilian voter registration number has a compatible UF code and check digits, without querying electoral status.

form.title: Validate Brazilian voter ID
form.description: Type or paste a number to check structure, UF code, and Modulo 11 check digits.

input.title: Voter ID number
input.label: Título de Eleitor number
input.privacy: The check runs in your browser. The number does not enter the default URL and is not sent to the server by this tool.
input.hint: Use only the voter registration number. Dots, spaces, and hyphens are accepted as visual separators.

fragment.hydrated: The number came from a link with explicit content. The address bar has been cleaned; the next share omits the number by default.
fragment.omitted: Link content was ignored for safety or because it exceeded the accepted limit.

share.title: Share
share.description: The default link shares only the tool route, without the typed number.
share.includeContentHint: Use only when the recipient is allowed to see the number. The value goes only in the URL fragment.
share.safe: Default sharing includes no voter number, UF, check digits, result, official query, or history.

result.title: Result
result.description: The result shows mathematical structure, not official electoral status.
result.emptyDescription: Type a number to start the local check.
result.validDescription: The UF and both check digits match the public Modulo 11 rule.
result.invalidChecksumDescription: The check digits do not match the sequence and UF provided.
result.invalidUfDescription: The UF code must be between 01 and 28.
result.attentionDescription: The check used a version padded with leading zeros. Compare it with the official document or e-Título before using it.
result.incompleteDescription: Enter more digits to form a voter registration number with up to 12 digits.
result.leftPaddedHint: Leading zeros were added only for the mathematical check.
result.checkDigitUnavailable: Unavailable until there is enough valid format to calculate.

explanation.empty: Local checking tool. It does not query Brazilian electoral databases.
explanation.incomplete: There are not enough digits yet to split sequence, UF, and check digits.
explanation.attention: The digits match for the canonical version with leading zeros, but this does not confirm registration or regular status.
explanation.attentionValidChecksum: The digits match for the canonical version with leading zeros, but this does not confirm registration or regular status.
explanation.attentionInvalidChecksum: The canonical version with leading zeros still has mismatched check digits. Compare it with the document or e-Título before using it.
explanation.invalidFormat: Fix characters, length, or repeated sequences before interpreting the check digits.
explanation.invalidUf: The UF code is not in the public electoral registration code table.
explanation.invalidChecksum: There may be a typo, wrong UF, swapped digit, or incomplete number.
explanation.validChecksum: The structure and digits match the public mathematical rule. This does not prove the title exists, is regular, or belongs to a person.

input.label: Input
input.pass: There is no relevant outer whitespace.

characters.label: Characters
characters.pass: Only digits and accepted visual separators were used.

length.label: Length
length.pass: There are 12 canonical digits to check.

uf.label: UF
uf.pass: The UF code is in the 01 to 28 table.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.pass: The number stays in the browser by default.

issues.empty: There is no number to validate yet.
issues.trimmedWhitespace: Whitespace at the beginning or end was ignored for validation.
issues.unsupportedCharacters: Remove letters, emoji, unsupported punctuation, or non-ASCII digits.
issues.incompleteLength: Use at least 5 digits for a leading-zero check, or 12 digits for the canonical format.
issues.tooLong: A canonical Brazilian voter registration number has at most 12 digits.
issues.leftPadded: The check used leading zeros to form 12 digits.
issues.repeatedDigits: Sequences with all digits equal are rejected even if a calculation happens to match.
issues.invalidUf: The UF code must be between 01 and 28.
issues.checksumUnavailable: Check digits do not run while format, length, or UF still has a problem.
issues.invalidChecksum: The final digits do not match the Modulo 11 expectation.
issues.validChecksum: The final digits match the Modulo 11 expectation.
issues.localOnly: The number stays in your browser, does not enter the default URL, is not saved, and is not sent to the server.

summary.scope: Scope: local check of format, UF, and check digits; it does not confirm electoral status, identity, polling place, or regularity.

details.title: What this validation covers
details.description: The tool checks only local public rules for the numeric structure.

structure.title: Number structure
structure.description: Splits eight sequence digits, two UF digits, and two check digits.

modulo.title: Modulo 11
modulo.description: Calculates both check digits using the public convention for Brazilian voter IDs.

noLookup.title: No TSE lookup
noLookup.description: Does not query status, discharge, electoral zone, section, polling place, registration, or e-Título.

privacy.title: Link privacy
privacy.description: The default URL, copied summary, and default share link do not carry the full number.

privacy.question: Is the voter ID sent to the server?
privacy.answer: Not by this tool. The check runs in the browser, and the number does not enter the default URL or default shared link.

checks.question: What does this validator check?
checks.answer: It checks length, UF code, and two check digits using the public Modulo 11 rule.

official.question: Does a matching number mean regular status with TSE?
official.answer: No. Matching digits only show mathematical consistency. Use official Justiça Eleitoral channels for status, discharge, e-Título, or polling place.

uf.question: What is the UF code?
uf.answer: It is the ninth and tenth digits, associated with the electoral registration UF or code 28 for abroad.

leftPadding.question: Why does the result mention leading zeros?
leftPadding.answer: The public rule describes a number with up to 12 digits. When the typed value is shorter, the tool can show a canonical version with leading zeros for comparison.

sharing.question: Can I share a link with the number filled in?
sharing.answer: Yes, but only after explicitly selecting content sharing. The default link omits the number.

seo.aboutTitle: About the Brazilian voter ID validator
seo.about: The Brazilian voter ID validator locally checks whether a sequence matches the 12-digit electoral registration structure: sequence, UF code, and two Modulo 11 check digits. It does not query Justiça Eleitoral and does not confirm status, regularity, identity, or polling place.
seo.howToUseTitle: How to validate a Título de Eleitor number
seo.howToUse: Type or paste the number, then review the status, UF, and check-digit checklist. Use the result as a typing aid; for official electoral status, e-Título, Título Net, or polling place, use TSE services.
